title: Electrochemical detection of diclofenac and clindamycin using ZnO nanorods/RGO nanocomposite modified electrode
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49094-49108
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07011B, Paper
Open Access

Gokul Sridharan, Surendar Balu, Raji Atchudan, Chandramohan Govindasamy, Dhanraj Ganapathy, Sandeep Arya, Ashok K. Sundramoorthy
A new electrochemical sensor based on electrochemically reduced graphene oxide (RGO) and zinc oxide (ZnO) nanorods was developed for the determination of the nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (Diclofenac) and antibiotic drug (Clindamycin).
